description: Q03/D21: the equation (9) rectify-lowpass envelope under a channel-relative cutoff min(f_cut, b_c) against the f_c/4 alternative, measured on an AM tone per channel. Records the table that appears in QUESTIONS.md Q03 as data.
channels_comment: The four channels quoted in the Q03 table, f_c approximately 196, 479, 953 and 3057 Hz. This is test_F4's bank, which is what the original Q03 measurement used.

stimulus.comment: Carrier at the channel's own centre frequency, as test_F4 builds it; trim discards the filter startup transient at both ends.

seed_comment: Deterministic stimulus and path; nothing for a seed to vary.
